text_overrides.ordinary_1: Not too bad. I'm in no hurry.
text_overrides.ordinary_2: Not too bad. I like the quiet when I'm fishing.
text_overrides.ordinary_3: Can't complain. Nice having someone to talk to.
text_overrides.content_1: I'm in a good mood, actually.
text_overrides.content_2: Feeling good. I'm always happy with a fishing rod in hand.
text_overrides.content_3: Well, thank you. Nothing much troubling me.
text_overrides.stressed_1: I've got a lot on my mind.
